how_recorded: 2026-09-25 (gate r just after midnight), on the desktop PC, FACTORIO_RL_GAME_SPEED=120, one worker per run. A job script reset `FactorioEnv(belt_smelting, split)` to each index of the seed plan, set `belt_smelting.EXTRA_COAL` to the run's --extra, ran `tasks.reference._solver_for('belt_smelting')` through a `Driver`, and printed one JSON record per episode. Gates f and r ran on a checkout at b0efe7c whose belt_smelting.py matches e49f28c's code (only its docstring's episode count differs); j, m0, n0 and n70 ran earlier that day, before `finish` was added.
result: Gates f and r together, 60 coal, the build ending on `finish`: 200 of 200 scenes delivered at least 150 plates, every train and test index 0-99 once, 197-198 plates each. Two f episodes ended on a transport error and were rerun in r. No completed episode at 60 or 90 coal failed; at 20 coal none succeeded.
